summary: Fixed Page 2 TIN + Taxpayer's Name concatenation by splitting the single 40-slot p2c5 comb into separate TIN (p2c5a..p2c5d) and Taxpayer's Name (p2c5e) combs in html-frozen/2000-dst-2018/{index.html,writer-cells.json}, and replaced all 64 raw developer cell-ID labels for 2000 in forms/forms-schema.json with plain labels. Confirmed Page 2 DST/ATC reference table is lifted to guide.html (by design) and Schedule 1 Tax Rate prints when ATC description is set from the dropdown. Comb-tick collisions on long names/addresses remain needs shared change.

defects.where: Page 2 top bar (TIN and Taxpayer's Name, p2c5)
defects.what: Split p2c5 into p2c5a..p2c5d (14 TIN comb slots wired to frm2000:txtPg2TIN1..3 and txtPg2BranchCode) and p2c5e (26 Taxpayer's Name slots wired to frm2000:txtPg2TaxpayerName), eliminating TIN+Name concatenation when the name overflows 26 characters.

defects.where: Page 2 Schedule 1 Tax Rate column (p2c15, p2c23, p2c31)
defects.what: Verified p2c15/p2c23/p2c31 are joined to frm2000:sched1:txtTaxRate0..2; rate_text() in bir-core requires both atc_code and matching description (selecting from the ATC dropdown populates it; synthetic fill only set drpATCCode0).

defects.where: Page 1 Items 6, 7, 10, 12 and Page 2 Taxpayer's Name
defects.what: Long taxpayer name, address, line of business, Other Party name, and Page 2 Taxpayer's Name switch out of comb mode and collide with comb ticks.
Official BIR 2000 Page 2 DST/ATC reference table (DS 101..DS 130) is intentionally lifted off the printed sheet into html-frozen/2000-dst-2018/guide.html by tools/formgen/guides.py.

defects.where: Schedules 1-4 in forms/forms-schema.json (64 entries including row templates)
defects.what: Replaced all 64 raw developer cell-ID labels (sched1:txtTaxBase0, :txt tax base, etc.) with plain human-readable labels matching the BIR 2000 column headers.
Reads 'Page 1' under 'January 2018 (ENCS)' on Page 2; matches the official BIR 2000 PDF verbatim (the official BIR PDF itself has this typo).

shared_changes_wanted: neon-4 (try/forms-shared-print): comb-tick collisions on long names, addresses, line of business, and Other Party name
crates/bir-print/src/fixtures/{fitting-band-goldens,fitting-goldens,overflow-goldens}.json: refresh 2000-dst-2018 SHA-256 hashes (not edited to avoid touching crates/)
tests_run: Live Linux WebKitGTK Print Preview and screen captures verified for 2000 (Page 2 TIN digits now fill 14 comb cells cleanly and Taxpayer's Name starts in its own column; crates/bir-print/src/fixtures/*.json left untouched)
